Maya Patel: Heads-up — CI is flaking on the canary integration suite. I think it's the new encoder migration. Can we extend the change window by 30m so I can push a tiny release-note wording fix and re-run the smoke?
Alex Chen: Where is it failing? only CI or did canary show anything?
Maya Patel: Only CI. Unit + integration intermittently failing on encoder schema mismatch. Canary traces look normal, no error rate in prod.
deploy-bot: [automated] Current quiet window: 2026-11-02T21:00:00Z -> 2026-11-02T23:00:00Z. To request extension, post in thread with approvers. Request logged by @Maya Patel.
Sophie Li: +1 to extend if PM is ok. I saw PM ping earlier about the RN wording.
Maya Patel: PM (Jules) gave verbal ok in #product — it's literally a one-line wording tweak under "Known Limitations". I'll paste diff below.
Maya Patel: ```diff
- Known issue: encoder may drop trailing whitespace on short prompts.
+ Known issue: encoder may drop trailing whitespace on <50-char prompts under certain batching conditions.
```
Alex Chen: Ok. If you're pushing an RN change only, pin the release artifact to avoid accidental model swap. I'll handle pinning if you confirm artifact hash.
Maya Patel: Artifact is v2.1.3, sha256: 9f3b2a... (shortened). Please pin and hold canary traffic if CI keeps failing.
Alex Chen: Running: `/deploy pin artifact v2.1.3 --reason "freeze-ext by Maya: RN tweak"`
ops-runner: I'll watch infra metrics and keeper alarms. If canary error rate > 0.5% or p99 latency +200ms, we'll unpin and fallback to v2.1.2. Ops runbook snippet: `if spike -> /deploy rollback-canary-to v2.1.2 && alert #incidents`.
Sophie Li: I'll update the changelog entry and post the final RN in #release-notes for signoff.
Maya Patel: Thanks team. Pushing RN now and re-running the flaky tests. Will report back in ~15m. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
deploy-bot: [automated] Extension approved: +30m to quiet window by channel owners. New quiet window end: 2026-11-02T23:30:00Z. Pin action observed: artifact v2.1.3 pinned by Alex Chen.
Alex Chen: Confirmed pin success. Monitoring canary. :thumbsup:
Maya Patel: Tests green on rerun — merging RN and closing this. Thanks all. :party:
